stories.headline: Anthropic signs $35 billion cloud deal with Nvidia backing
stories.blurb: Nvidia is supplying chips to a Texas data center and holding the lease for Anthropic's cloud infrastructure. The deal shows Nvidia using its balance sheet to lock in a major AI customer while securing long-term chip demand for its hardware.
stories.why_it_matters: Nvidia is now both supplier and landlord to the companies building frontier AI models.
stories.original_headline: Anthropic Signs $35 Billion Cloud Deal Backed by Nvidia

stories.headline: The Pentagon just put ChatGPT and Grok on its central AI portal
stories.blurb: OpenAI's ChatGPT and SpaceXAI's Grok are now available on the Pentagon's central portal for AI tools, joining Google's Gemini. Defense personnel can now access multiple commercial AI models through a single government gateway instead of using public versions.
stories.why_it_matters: The military is treating AI chat tools like standard-issue software, not experimental tech.
stories.original_headline: The Pentagon now has its own version of ChatGPT and Grok

stories.headline: Waymo robotaxis are coming to Denver, San Diego, and Tampa
stories.blurb: Alphabet's Waymo just announced it's launching driverless rides in three new cities. The expansion brings the robotaxi service beyond its current markets in San Francisco, Phoenix, Los Angeles, and Austin.
stories.why_it_matters: Autonomous rides are becoming available to millions more Americans this year.
stories.original_headline: Waymo is launching its robotaxi in Denver, San Diego, and Tampa

stories.headline: Perplexity now routes sensitive queries to your local AI model
stories.blurb: Perplexity's new Hybrid Compute feature automatically detects when you're asking something private and runs it on your device instead of their cloud. You can manually toggle it too, and it works with any model you've got running locally through Ollama or LM Studio.
stories.why_it_matters: You can finally use a powerful search AI without sending every personal question to the cloud.
stories.original_headline: Perplexity's Hybrid Compute splits sensitive tasks between cloud and local AI
